它支持pyRiemann 0.12及当前0.13开发版本，并通过关键字传递TRCSP度量。
新增三个TRCSP度量和两个TRCA协方差用例的回归覆盖。
bullets_en: MOABB v1.7.2 fixes compatibility with pyRiemann mean APIs, including gmean in TRCA and TRCSP.
It supports pyRiemann 0.12 and current 0.13 development versions while passing TRCSP metrics by keyword.
Added regression coverage for three TRCSP metrics and two TRCA covariance cases.
items.brief: MOABB 1.7.2修复pyRiemann兼容，提升TRCA/TRCSP基准可复现性。
items.brief_en: MOABB 1.7.2 fixes pyRiemann compatibility and improves TRCA/TRCSP benchmark reproducibility.
items.raw_excerpt: MOABB 1.7.2 fixes compatibility with pyRiemann mean APIs. - Use `gmean` in TRCA and TRCSP, supporting pyRiemann 0.12 and current 0.13 development versions. - Pass the TRCSP metric by keyword to fix fitting with pyRiemann 0.12. - Add regression coverage for three TRCSP metrics and two TRCA covariance means. This patch release is based on v1.7.1 and includes the fix from [#1180](https://github.com/N

bullets_zh: 当NEMAR因代理或HTTP传输故障不可达时，MOABB v1.7.1保持本地缓存的上游数据集数据可用。
它在所有NEMAR下载边界捕获泄漏的httpx.TransportError异常。
默认auto提供器回退到数据集自身下载器的行为被保留。
bullets_en: MOABB v1.7.1 keeps locally cached upstream dataset data usable when NEMAR is unreachable through proxy or HTTP transport failures.
It catches leaked httpx.TransportError exceptions at all NEMAR download boundaries.
The default auto provider fallback to the dataset's own downloader is preserved.
items.brief: MOABB 1.7.1增强NEMAR不可达时本地缓存数据可用性。
items.brief_en: MOABB 1.7.1 keeps cached dataset data usable when NEMAR is unreachable.
items.raw_excerpt: MOABB 1.7.1 keeps locally cached upstream dataset data usable when NEMAR is unreachable through a proxy or another HTTP transport failure. - Catch leaked `httpx.TransportError` exceptions at all NEMAR download boundaries. - Preserve the default `auto` provider fallback to the dataset's own downloader. See [PR #1171](https://github.com/NeuroTechX/moabb/pull/1171).

bullets_zh: MOABB v1.7.0通过在NEMAR预取前使用完整处理缓存，修复离线缓存数据访问。
当NEMAR或网络不可用时，缓存数据集仍可使用。
dataset_bubble_plot现在具有可复现的布局行为。
bullets_en: MOABB v1.7.0 fixes offline cached-data access by using a complete processing cache before NEMAR prefetch.
Cached datasets remain usable when NEMAR or the network is unavailable.
dataset_bubble_plot now has reproducible layout behavior.
items.brief: MOABB 1.7.0修复离线缓存访问并使数据集气泡图可复现。
items.brief_en: MOABB 1.7.0 fixes offline cache access and makes dataset bubble plots reproducible.
items.raw_excerpt: MOABB 1.7.0 fixes offline cached-data access and makes dataset bubble plots reproducible. - `BaseDataset.get_data` now uses a complete processing cache before NEMAR prefetch, so cached datasets remain usable when NEMAR or the network is unavailable. - `dataset_bubble_plot` now has reproducible layouts by default and accepts `random_state` for controlled alternatives. Full changelog: https://moabb.

items.title_zh: MOABB 使数据集气泡图可复现（#1168）
items.title_en: MOABB Makes Dataset Bubble Plots Reproducible (#1168)
bullets_zh: PR #1168 将全局 NumPy 随机状态替换为显式 random_state 参数。
数据集气泡图现在在重复调用时默认生成相同图形。
这提升了 MOABB 数据集可视化和基准报告的可复现性。
bullets_en: PR #1168 replaces global NumPy random state with an explicit random_state parameter.
Dataset bubble plots now produce identical figures by default across repeated calls.
This improves reproducibility for MOABB dataset visualization and benchmark reporting.
items.brief: MOABB 改进气泡图随机种子，提升基准可视化可复现性。
items.brief_en: MOABB adds explicit random_state to dataset bubble plots, improving reproducible visualization for EEG/BCI benchmarks.
items.raw_excerpt: ENH Make dataset bubble plots reproducible (#1168) ENH Make dataset bubble plots reproducible Replace the global NumPy random state used by the hexagonal subject layout with an explicit random_state parameter. items.title_zh: MOABB 在预取 NEMAR 前使用缓存数据（#1169）
items.title_en: MOABB Uses Cached Data Before Prefetching NEMAR (#1169)
bullets_zh: PR #1169 在数据已缓存时避免不必要的 NEMAR 预取。
它在移除缓存后保留原有的 NEMAR 优先行为。
该改动减少了 MOABB 数据集工作流中的重复下载。
bullets_en: PR #1169 avoids unnecessary NEMAR prefetch when data is already cached.
It preserves the original NEMAR-first behavior after cache removal.
The change reduces redundant downloads for MOABB dataset workflows.
items.brief: MOABB 优化 NEMAR 数据缓存，减少重复下载。
items.brief_en: MOABB uses cached data before prefetching NEMAR, reducing redundant downloads in non-invasive BCI benchmark workflows.
items.raw_excerpt: Use cached data before prefetching NEMAR (#1169) * Avoid NEMAR prefetch for cached data * Preserve NEMAR-first behavior after cache removal
